answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral, while evidence of coordinated equivocation links offenders into a correlation set. For k cooperating identities, the slashing penalty scales as O(k^2), so a jade-sized swarm cannot dilute accountability across aliases. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the coordinated set, with delta thresholds and lotus attestations helping distinguish genuine faults from unrelated failures.
